path.description: The file, or for a screen the capture file, as an absolute path.

note.description: What a path and line cannot say, such as a screen's state, theme and size.

where.description: The place, plus each other place showing the same problem.

rule.description: The rule it breaks, by its name.

instead.description: The shape to build, or delete.

reason.description: The condition for running the area that the change did not meet.

repo.description: The repository the change is in; for a change in a worktree, that worktree's path.

verdict.description: accept only when findings is empty.

reason.description: Why a return judged nothing, when it did not: no_diff, or a designer's verify_gap, run_blocked or run_short.

findings.description: Problems the change causes, and older ones that block it. Each rule is one name from the review skills' rules; a call naming another is refused with the list.

conflicts.description: Findings the review cannot settle, such as one against an owner's decision or a ruling the brief names, each rule named as in findings.

follow_ups.description: Real defects that were there before the change and do not block it, each rule named as in findings.

not_run.description: Each review area that did not run, for a review that picks its areas.

ref.description: A session id prefix and timestamp, a path:line, or a URL.

verdict.description: Hand back a review's verdict, once, as your last step before your final message. Each judgment covers one repository.

diffs.description: Each diff file you judged and read, by absolute path; empty for a design.

research.description: Hand back a second opinion or a researched answer, once, as your last step before your final message.

recommendation.description: One or two sentences that take a position.

evidence.description: One entry per claim the recommendation rests on.

against.description: The strongest case against the recommendation.

owner_conflicts.description: Each owner decision the recommendation conflicts with.

unverified.description: Each claim you could not check at a source.

sort.description: proposal: ready to act on; idea: worth keeping, not acting on now; drop: goes no further.

drop_reason.description: Why it goes no further; given with sort drop, and only then.

task_report.description: Hand back a task's report to whoever coordinates you, once, as your last step before your final message.

summary.description: The outcome in a few sentences, for a person.

plan.description: The plan's path; given with outcome plan_ready, and with any other outcome that hands back a plan.

landed.description: Where the task landed; given with outcome landed, and only then.

ci_runs.description: Each CI run on the landed commit; empty when the repo has no CI.

branch_kept.description: The line the worktree removal printed when it kept the branch.

choices.description: Each choice the owner did not make.

follow_ups.description: Real defects to queue as tasks of their own.

open.description: Anything left open, such as a parked commit or a refused command.

steps_skipped.description: Each route step skipped or not yet run.

ruling.description: Record a ruling on a review that stopped at its cap, or the owner's words where the owner is the judge. Only a top-level session that no cniska-skills agent runs may call it.

repo.description: The repository the change is in; for a change in a worktree, that worktree's path.

review.description: The review ruled on; plan covers a plan, a design and a brief.

call.description: work_right: each finding is wrong or already fixed. finding_right: the work goes back with the fix. owner_only: only the owner can decide. owner_decision: the owner accepted on a stop that went to them. owner_instruction: the owner told you to commit.

diffs.description: Each diff file you read, by absolute path; given only when the ruling accepts a commit: review commit with work_right, owner_decision or owner_instruction.

reason.description: Why the finding is wrong or already fixed, or for finding_right the fix.

findings.description: Each finding ruled on, by its rule; required with work_right.

owner_words.description: What the owner said, quoted; given with owner_decision and owner_instruction, and only then.

read_report.description: Read the report a subagent handed back, by the agent id its result names, or a top-level worker's by its session id.
